subject: general
question: What is the effect of heating on the rate of diffusion?

options.text: It first increases and then, decreases after some time.
It increases with increase of temperature
It decreases with increase of temperature
There is no effect of temperature on the rate of diffusion.

solution:
The correct answer is __**It increases with increase of temperature**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The rate of diffusion is directly proportional to temperature.
 
• As temperature increases, the kinetic energy of particles also increases.
 
• Higher kinetic energy results in particles moving faster.
 
• Faster movement of particles leads to an increased rate of diffusion.
